name: ThemeSwitch
description: A three-state theme preference: an explicit light, an explicit dark, or deferring to the operating system. Native radios carry the semantics, so the control works inside a form with no JavaScript. The chosen mode is written to the document root verbatim, `system` included, because the stylesheet resolves that case through a media query.

modelValue.description: The chosen mode. Anything that is not light, dark or system falls back to system.
